pyramiding_rule: Zero pyramiding into losing positions or moving average convergence zones; scale-ins are strictly prohibited unless the initial position is already at +1R floating profit with stop-loss locked at breakeven.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a minimum 14-period ATR volatility normalization filter and absolute block on entries within 15 minutes of high-impact macroeconomic news wicks.
profit_harvest_threshold: Trigger partial profit scaling at +$10.00 and full trailing execution before floating profits degrade by more than 30% from peak.
